raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: rbloom
  version: "1.5.4"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: ea6804f837c14d8ff041b07df8666798ac1ddcab709e139d06b0ea69d627f827

build:
  number: 3
  script:
    - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml
    - python -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler("cxx") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pip
        - python
        - maturin >=1.0,<2
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - maturin >=1.0,<2
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - rbloom
  - script:
      - pip check
      - python run_test.py
    files:
      recipe:
        - run_test.py
    requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/KenanHanke/rbloom
  repository: https://github.com/KenanHanke/rbloom
  summary: A fast, simple and lightweight Bloom filter library for Python, implemented in Rust
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
    - LICENSE

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jeongseok-meta
